newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-St George outsources cheque operation.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-St George outsources cheque operation.

text.p: St George Bank Ltd managing director Jim Sweeney said on Thursday that the bank had decided to outsource its cheque processing operations to an overseas bank which had Australian operations.
He also said the bank was considering outsourcing its mortgage processing operations to a local bank.

Sweeney said St George had decided to outsource its mortgage processing operations and was considering using the Westpac Banking Corp Mortgage Processing centre in Adelaide, but that other local banks were interested.
"The decision has basically been taken," Sweeney told reporters after an address to a conference on Financial Services.
He said St George was looking to outsource its back office and information technology needs where possible, aiming to cut costs and improve efficiency.
